findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: genesis_items · Private data: extensions_report_gap, activities_participation · Public sink: genesis_items, knowledge_lens, propose_type · Destructive: genesis_items, views_checks.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: genesis_items · Private data: extensions_report_gap, activities_participation · Public sink: genesis_items, knowledge_lens, propose_type · Destructive: genesis_items, views_checks

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
